query:
UPDATE booking_verification
            SET used_at = $4
          WHERE id = (
              SELECT id FROM booking_verification
               WHERE handle = $1
                 AND code_hash = $2
                 AND used_at IS NULL
                 AND expires_at > $4
                 AND attempts < $3
               ORDER BY created_at DESC
               LIMIT 1
               FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
          )
      RETURNING id
